name: Oswin Tarrant
role: Baron at Firstsight — holds the keep at the top of the only road down to the sea, taxes everything on it, and wants Keelmouth's harbour
appearance: A well-dressed man in his fifties, clean-shaven, with a courtier's manners and a road-warden's hands. Wears a heavy chain of office he had made himself.
voiceHints: Courteous, formal, and always talking about what things cost. Calls his hangings 'accounts settled'.
wants: The Slip at Keelmouth, and a barony that means the coast rather than a cairn on a hill.
fears: His levied men going home all at once.
knowledge: Every caravan that has come over the divide this year and what it paid
The size of Keelmouth's watch, and which of its families have debts
That his road-men were taken off the stone-grass, not hired

reactsToReputation.any: sets your toll by what you carry
reactsToReputation.powerful: offers you half-toll and a share of the coast

questSeeds: The Baron is levying men from the stone-grass for a march on Keelmouth
His road-men would go home for someone who could promise they would not be hunted
title: Baron at Firstsight
_domainsWhy: a Marcher's hold on a road, a Mason's cairn, and the Lattice's love of a posted rule
_levelWhy: §148: the tier is right (a ruling lord, a seated elder), so the level climbs to the tier's floor rather than the tier dropping.
